snippet.title: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon - Trailer
snippet.description:
Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon is the cruise line tycoon I'm making for PC and Mac, coming to Steam in November 2026.

Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, staff it, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests happy - or set loose a kraken, a lightning storm and pirates and see if she stays afloat.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5476120
